executive_summary: The EXEC-TO-PLAN handoff's MANDATORY_TESTING_VALIDATION gate (required:true) reads a stored sub_agent_execution_results TESTING row and fails unless its verdict is PASS/CONDITIONAL_PASS. TESTING's own phase4-evidence.js requires user_stories.status IN (completed, validated) to count a story implemented, and the only promoter (auto-validate-user-stories-on-exec-complete.js) requires every sd_scope_deliverables row already completed. Deliverables only reach completed via code that runs INSIDE the exec-to-plan executor itself (exec-to-plan/index.js:412, or gates/deliverables-completeness.js's reconcileDeliverables), never before it. Because sub-agent-orchestration.js reuses a fresh cached TESTING row instead of re-running TESTING inside the handoff, the pre-handoff standalone TESTING run required by CLAUDE.md protocol is the ONLY evaluation that can ever produce the row MANDATORY_TESTING_VALIDATION reads -- and it structurally cannot observe healed state. Every SD with genuinely-real-but-still-pending deliverables therefore fails TESTING and the tooling recommends --bypass-validation, the wrong fix for a structural ordering bug. This PRD makes TESTING heal-then-measure: before verifying user stories, it reconciles deliverables using the SAME evidence-gated reconciler the gate itself uses (never the zero-evidence auto-complete fallback), then re-checks. The fix is scoped strictly to the POST_IMPLEMENTATION handoff types (EXEC-TO-PLAN, PLAN-VERIFY) via the existing resolveStoryGateContext() classifier; PRE_IMPLEMENTATION callers (PLAN-TO-EXEC, PLAN_PRD) are explicitly untouched, and no downstream gate's verdict-acceptance logic changes.

functional_requirements.title: TESTING heals deliverables before measuring story completeness, for POST_IMPLEMENTATION callers only
functional_requirements.description: In lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js, hoist the existing resolveStoryGateContext(options) call (currently computed later at line ~231, only for classification) to run BEFORE verifyUserStories() (currently invoked at line ~212). When context.blocking === true (POST_IMPLEMENTATION: EXEC-TO-PLAN, PLAN-VERIFY, matching the classifier's existing PRE/POST_IMPLEMENTATION sets), call the evidence-gated reconciler exported from gates/deliverables-completeness.js (currently private -- export reconcileDeliverables) for the SD's sd_scope_deliverables rows, then call the canonical promoter scripts/auto-validate-user-stories-on-exec-complete.js's autoValidateUserStories(sdId, supabase) (already a safe no-op when deliverables remain incomplete), THEN run the existing verifyUserStories() measurement unchanged. When context.blocking is false or absent (PRE_IMPLEMENTATION: PLAN-TO-EXEC, PLAN_PRD), skip the heal step entirely -- TESTING measures exactly what it measures today.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture SD with real-but-unmarked deliverables (matching one of reconcileDeliverables()'s existing evidence checks: PRD active, or accepted EXEC handoff + functional-requirement keyword match) reaches TESTING verdict PASS on a standalone POST_IMPLEMENTATION run, with no --bypass-validation flag used.

A negative test asserts TESTING invoked with phase='PLAN_PRD' or handoffType='PLAN-TO-EXEC' never writes to sd_scope_deliverables or user_stories -- the heal step must not fire for PRE_IMPLEMENTATION callers.

The remediation text mandatory-testing-validation.js emits on failure no longer recommends --bypass-validation for a condition this handoff itself now resolves; it is updated only if the fixture in AC-1 still leaves a genuine gap to describe.

functional_requirements.title: The heal step must NEVER use the zero-evidence auto-complete fallback tier
functional_requirements.description: scripts/modules/handoff/auto-complete-deliverables.js's autoCompleteDeliverables() (called by exec-to-plan/index.js:412 via autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD) has an unconditional final fallback tier, AUTO_COMPLETE_HANDOFF_CONTEXT (confidence 50, fires when 'no verification sources matched', lines ~364-379), that marks a deliverable completed with NO real evidence, by design. FR-1's heal step must call ONLY gates/deliverables-completeness.js's reconcileDeliverables() (which leaves an unmatched deliverable untouched rather than rubber-stamping it) and must not import or call autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD / autoCompleteDeliverables from lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js under any circumstance. This is the load-bearing safety property: a standalone TESTING run must never be able to fabricate the evidence it then measures against (CLAUDE.md's chairman-ratified gate-evidence-provenance rule: 'No completion gate may accept evidence authored by the party it gates').
acceptance_criteria: A static/import-check test asserts lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js never imports autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD or autoCompleteDeliverables from scripts/modules/handoff/auto-complete-deliverables.js or exec-to-plan/index.js.

A fixture with a deliverable that matches NONE of reconcileDeliverables()'s 5 evidence checks remains incomplete after the heal step runs, and TESTING correctly reports the story as still-unimplemented (not fabricated-complete).

functional_requirements.title: No downstream gate's verdict-acceptance logic changes
functional_requirements.description: mandatory-testing-validation.js's accepted-verdict list (PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS) and subagent-evidence-gate.js's rule that a recorded rejecting verdict (BLOCKED/FAIL) always fails the gate in every mode (hardened by SD-LEO-FIX-EXEC-PLAN-ACCEPTED-001 / PR #8059, precisely because a softened TESTING verdict once let a broken SD read as completed) are explicit non-negotiables for this SD. This SD changes what TESTING measures before producing a verdict; it must never change what verdict a downstream gate accepts.
acceptance_criteria: git diff for this SD's PR touches no line in mandatory-testing-validation.js's verdict-acceptance array or subagent-evidence-gate.js's rejecting-verdict handling.
A regression test re-runs SD-LEO-FIX-EXEC-PLAN-ACCEPTED-001's own fixture (a genuinely BLOCKED TESTING verdict) and confirms it still fails the gate after this change.

technical_requirements.title: Reuse resolveStoryGateContext(), never reimplement its PRE/POST_IMPLEMENTATION classification
technical_requirements.description: lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js:405-426 (added by QF-20260903-748) already classifies handoffType/phase into PRE_IMPLEMENTATION vs POST_IMPLEMENTATION with a blocking boolean. The heal-step gate condition must call this existing function, not duplicate its handoffType/phase mapping.

technical_requirements.title: Export reconcileDeliverables from gates/deliverables-completeness.js
technical_requirements.description: Currently private/unexported. Add a named export so lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js can import and call it directly, without duplicating its 5 evidence checks.

test_scenarios.scenario: POST_IMPLEMENTATION TESTING run heals real-but-pending deliverables and reaches PASS
test_scenarios.expected: Fixture SD with a PRD-active deliverable and matching evidence reaches verdict PASS without --bypass-validation, sd_scope_deliverables and user_stories rows correctly promoted.

test_scenarios.scenario: PRE_IMPLEMENTATION TESTING run does not heal
test_scenarios.expected: TESTING invoked with handoffType='PLAN-TO-EXEC' or phase='PLAN_PRD' makes zero writes to sd_scope_deliverables/user_stories, verdict reflects the genuinely-unimplemented state.

test_scenarios.scenario: Heal step never fabricates completion via the zero-evidence fallback
test_scenarios.expected: A deliverable matching none of reconcileDeliverables()'s evidence checks stays incomplete; TESTING reports the true gap, not a fabricated pass.

test_scenarios.scenario: Prior ACCEPTED-001 regression fixture still fails correctly
test_scenarios.expected: A genuinely BLOCKED TESTING verdict still fails mandatory-testing-validation.js and subagent-evidence-gate.js after this change -- no weakening of verdict acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: A standalone `execute-subagent.js --code TESTING --sd-id <SD>` run on a genuinely-complete-but-unmarked SD reaches PASS/CONDITIONAL_PASS without --bypass-validation.
PRE_IMPLEMENTATION TESTING callers are provably unaffected (zero writes).
No verdict-acceptance gate logic changes; the ACCEPTED-001 regression fixture still fails as designed.

risks.risk: A naive implementation could wire the heal step to the zero-evidence autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD fallback, reproducing a self-authored-evidence defect one layer down.
risks.mitigation: FR-2 explicitly forbids this and requires an import-check test pinning it.

risks.risk: Broadening the heal step beyond POST_IMPLEMENTATION callers could let a PRE_IMPLEMENTATION run (evaluating deliberately-unimplemented work) fabricate premature completion.
risks.mitigation: FR-1 gates the heal step strictly on resolveStoryGateContext().blocking, reusing the already-tested classifier rather than a new one.

risks.risk: reconcileDeliverables() is partly circular for a pre-handoff run: some of its 5 evidence checks key off an accepted EXEC-TO-PLAN handoff, which does not exist yet at TESTING-standalone time.
risks.mitigation: This is expected and safe: those specific deliverables correctly remain incomplete until real evidence exists, matching current (correct) behavior for that evidence class.

observability_rollout: Unit test suite (TS-1..TS-4) is the verification story; no live-traffic rollout gate needed for a sub-agent library change

system_architecture.summary: TESTING sub-agent gains a heal-then-measure step, gated on the existing PRE/POST_IMPLEMENTATION classifier, using only the evidence-gated deliverables reconciler.
